details.text: A swath of damaging to occasionally severe gusts is becoming increasingly likely along the KS/MO border, including the Kansas City Metropolitan area. A few nearby supercell structures may also pose an occasional risk for severe hail

details.label: Discussion
details.text: An MCS is organizing over northeastern KS, with KEAX reflectivity and velocity data depicting the potential for hydrometeor loading given large merging cores. As a result, several severe gusts have been observed over the last 30 minutes. The current thinking is that appreciable outflow with these storms will yield a damaging to occasionally severe wind swath along the KS/MO border despite the decoupled boundary layer in place. These storms will pass over the Kansas City Metropolitan area over the next hour or so, accompanied by gusts occasionally exceeding 60 mph. Transient supercells are also flanking this MCS to the southwest with deeper cores, which may favor a few instances of severe hail as well
